integrity.provenance: mathematical proof and executable reproduction supplied

scientific_limitations: Only degree-at-most 2n-1 Gaussian Fock polynomials with n distinct common-circle sites, n>=2, and two individually normalized evaluation types.
The optimality criterion is Gram determinant; no claim of global planar design or noise-optimal condition number.
The e*4^(-n) ratio is proved asymptotically, and finite computations merely corroborate the theorem.
Older confluent-Hermite D-optimal design literature may contain an equivalent normalization-specific result.
title: D-optimal circular Hermite sampling in finite Gaussian Fock space and its exponential volume penalty
